# FedEx (FDX) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 074 | Published 2021-12-26 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-12-26/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/074.json)

Macro caution accompanies a FedEx valuation case.

The macro caution held up better than the near-term FedEx profit improvement rationale. Census data validate the e-commerce floor, while later earnings expose substantial operating leverage. The five-year relative stock test has not yet matured; no business-growth observation is counted as proof of shareholder outperformance.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Framework lessons

- Compare business quality with entry price.
- Separate cyclical stress from structural demand.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
- Audit removed duplicate074-C24: its original two-year EPS horizon was not supported by the text. Coverage retained in074-C25.
